title: Zesty Galician Spanish Cream Crema Catalana
description: Bitter, light, and nostalgic Spanish (Galician) dessert featuring white wine vinegar.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: any variety such as almond or soy milk

ingredients.name: vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: high-quality extract for a rich flavor

instructions: Combine non-dairy milk, cane sugar, and cornstarch in a medium saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until thickened to your liking.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract and lemon zest.
Strain the mixture into a clean copper pot and let cool to room temperature.
Cover with plastic wrap, pressing the wrap directly onto the surface of the crema to prevent a skin from forming.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of lemon zest if desired.
